# MarketForge Content Strategy

Read shared references and `ai-saturation-watch.md`. Apply V3 §3.3 (Content marketing — honest case for 2026).

## Global quality rules

- 20 deep expert-authored pieces > 200 AI-generated ones.
- POV + original data + named author > generic explainers.
- Distribution-first: content optimized for LinkedIn/X/newsletters first, search second.
- Bottom-funnel + product-led (comparison pages, integration pages, ROI calculators) over top-of-funnel volume.
- Topical authority still works for E-E-A-T but volume threshold dropped — quality over quantity.

## Purpose

Produce:
1. Content strategy thesis (what we believe; what we'll publish; what we won't).
2. Content type mix (POV, comparison, integration, original research, customer stories, etc.).
3. Publishing cadence (calibrated to budget tier + team capacity).
4. Content × audience-stage map.
5. Distribution plan (where content goes; how it's amplified).
6. Original research / data project plan (annual or semi-annual).

## Inputs

- `positioning.md`, `messaging-architecture.md`, `awareness-stages.md`, `icp-and-personas/`, `voice-of-customer.md`, `competitive-intel.md`, `channel-strategy.md`, `seo-strategy.md`, `geo-llmo.md`.

## Outputs

- `docs/marketing-plan/04-website-content/content-strategy.md`
- DEC-300 to DEC-329

## Structure

```markdown
# Content Strategy

## Thesis
[2-3 sentences capturing what we believe content should do, and what we won't do. Example: "We believe the highest-leverage content is bottom-funnel comparison pages + 4 deep POV pieces per quarter + 1 original-research report per year. We do NOT believe in publishing 4 blog posts per week, AI-generated 'ultimate guides,' or programmatic SEO with thin template-swap pages."]

## Content type mix

| Type | Goal | Frequency | Owner | Awareness stage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Comparison pages ("[us] vs [competitor]") | Bottom-funnel conversion | 1-2/month until full coverage | Content lead | Solution/Product-aware |
| Integration pages | Bottom-funnel + GEO | 1-2/month | Content lead | Product-aware |
| POV / opinion pieces | Founder brand + GEO citation | 1-2/month | Founder | Problem-aware |
| Original research / data report | Annual hero asset | 1/year (or quarterly if T3) | Cross-functional | Problem/Solution-aware |
| Customer case studies | Bottom-funnel social proof | 2-4/quarter | Customer-marketing lead | Product/Most-aware |
| Engineering / technical deep-dives | Dev-audience attraction | 1-2/month if dev-tool | Engineering + content | Problem/Solution-aware |
| Free tool / calculator | Engineering-as-marketing | 1-2/year per project | Product + content | Various |
| Newsletter (owned audience) | Compound asset | Weekly or biweekly | Content lead | Various |
| Podcast (host) | T3+ only | Weekly when justified | Podcaster role | Various |
| Podcast (guest) | High-leverage everywhere | 2-3/month | Founder | Problem/Solution-aware |

## Original research plan

[Annual or semi-annual original-data project. Specific topic. Methodology. Distribution plan. Press strategy. Becomes the year's hero content asset.]

Examples:
- "We surveyed 240 RevOps leaders about [topic]. Here's what we found."
- "Analysis of 1.2M [data points] reveals [pattern]."
- "Year in [category] — annual benchmark report."

## Publishing cadence by tier

| Tier | Realistic cadence |
|---|---|
| T1 | 1-2 deep pieces / month + 1 founder POV / week (LinkedIn primary) |
| T2 | 2-4 deep pieces / month + 1 POV / week + 1 case study / month |
| T3 | 4-8 deep pieces / month + dedicated original research + podcast hosting if justified |

## Content × stage map

[Per `awareness-stages.md` — which content type serves which stage.]

## Distribution plan (distribution > production)

For each major piece:
- LinkedIn carousel adaptation
- LinkedIn long-form post adaptation
- X/Twitter thread
- Newsletter inclusion
- Podcast topic (if relevant)
- Direct outreach to 10-20 specific people who'd engage
- Reddit post (where appropriate community)
- HackerNews submission (if technical + relevant)
- Repurposed quote cards for social
- Possible newsletter sponsorship placement reusing the asset

## What we are NOT publishing
- AI-generated "ultimate guide" content.
- Keyword-stuffed SEO articles.
- 4 shallow posts per week.
- Programmatic SEO with thin pages.
- Generic "[Topic] best practices" without POV.
- Ghostwritten LinkedIn content that doesn't sound like the founder.

## Editorial process

- Outline + claim chunking + sources before drafting.
- AI for outlines, first drafts, alt text, meta descriptions, transcripts, repurposing.
- Human for: POV, voice, original data, expertise, signed thought leadership.
- Sources cited inline (every claim).
- Named human author (no "Team [Brand]" bylines on POV content).

## E-E-A-T signals (still important post-AIO)
- Named authors with credentials + photos + LinkedIn links.
- Dates (created + updated).
- Sources cited with dates.
- Author bio pages.
- Schema markup (Article schema).

## Decision cards
[DEC-300 to DEC-329]

## Kill criteria
- Content piece: 12 months; no traffic, no inbound, no measurable engagement → review and either depublish or rewrite.
- Cluster: 12 months; no compounding curve → kill cluster.

## What we are intentionally NOT doing
- "Publish 100 AI articles" — HubSpot pattern.
- Keyword-stuffing for top-of-funnel.
- Ghostwritten founder content with detectable AI cadence.
- Programmatic SEO with thin pages.
- Vanity metrics (impressions, "average time on page") as primary KPIs.
```
